factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Satellite-tag studies in the North Atlantic and Southwest Atlantic report blue marlin spending most tracked time in warm surface waters, commonly around 26–30 °C; the Southwest Atlantic study (21 fish) reports most time at 26–28 °C.
